How good is Anthropic's Claude 3?

Michael SpencerMar 05, 2024∙ Paid336ShareHey Everyone, 

We have likely reached a point where a number of foundational LLM makers are reaching relative parity, the are: 

OpenAI

Mistral

Anthropic

Google DeepMind

Leading Chinese Models 

We saw this yesterday with the release of Claude 3. 

The generative AI field has exploded over the past year, with a record $29.1 billion invested across nearly 700 deals in 2023, a more than 260% increase in deal value from a year earlier, according to PitchBook.

Read the Blog

Whatever happens to OpenAI, Anthropic is now a well funded team that prioritizes safety, without trying to move too fast or do too much on the product side that might be risky or ill-advised. Claude 3 is a very impressive launch of models Opus, Sonnet and Haiku. 

Meanwhile Anthropic continues to expand what they can do for Enterprise and are listening to their customers building differentiators and providing specialized value.
